title: Liposomal irinotecan and capecitabine plus bevacizumab as second-line therapy in metastatic colorectal cancer: A multicenter, single-arm study.
abstract: Liposomal irinotecan, characterized by its favorable pharmacologic properties and reduced systemic toxicity compared to irinotecan, has demonstrated superior therapeutic potential. This multicenter, single-arm study was conducted to evaluate the efficacy and safety of liposomal irinotecan, capecitabine, and bevacizumab as a second-line treatment for metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC). title: Early-Life Polyethylene Microplastic Exposure Exacerbates ADHD-Like Behaviors in Mice via PI3K/AKT1/Nrf2 Signaling: Evidence From the Pilot Cohort and Multi-Omics Analyses.
abstract: Microplastic pollution may influence neurodevelopment, yet its relationship with attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) remains unclear. We integrated a pediatric cohort, multi-omics analyses, network toxicology, and animal experiments to investigate polyethylene (PE) microplastic exposure in ADHD vulnerability. title: Reconstruction of Large Femoral Segmental Defects in Conflict-Related Trauma Using Non-vascularized Fibular and Iliac Crest Grafts: A Case Series.
abstract: Introduction/objectives Large post-traumatic femoral segmental defects with established nonunion represent a challenging reconstructive problem, particularly in conflict-affected and resource-limited environments where access to microsurgical reconstruction and prolonged staged procedures may be limited. title: Proximal Fibular Epiphysiodesis or Resection May Alter Lower Limb Alignment in Growing Children.
abstract: Fibular head prominence causes prosthetic problems for children with below-knee amputations. It can be aggravated by a more proximal fibular location resulting from a mismatch in growth between the proximal fibula and tibia in tibial deficiency and tibiofibular synostoses. Proximal fibular epiphysiodeses or resections are commonly used to address prominence or for Marquardt amputation revisions. title: Flapless Piezoelectric Implant Surgery with Photobiomodulation: A Non-Clinical Mechanistic-Bayesian Framework and Study Protocol.
journal: Indian journal of dental research : official publication of Indian Society for Dental Research
abstract: Flapless guided placement, piezoelectric osteotomy, and photobiomodulation (PBM) each have individual biological rationale in implant surgery. Their combined, standardised use has not been prospectively validated. title: Bilateral Paradental Cyst of the Mandible - A Rare Case Report.
journal: Indian journal of dental research : official publication of Indian Society for Dental Research
abstract: The paradental cyst is an inflammatory lesion commonly misinterpreted when associated with atypical clinical and radiographic features, causing difficulty in diagnosis. For this reason, the correlation of clinical, histologic, and radiographic ﬁndings is of great value in obtaining accurate diagnoses. title: Differential Diagnosis of Early-Stage Pulmonary Sarcoidosis With Normal Serum Angiotensin-Converting Enzyme Activity Using Peripheral Blood Indicators: Machine Learning Models Development and Validation.
abstract: Early-stage pulmonary sarcoidosis with serum angiotensin-converting enzyme (sACE) activity within the normal range is difficult to distinguish from other pulmonary diseases with similar radiographic characteristics. This study aimed to develop and validate machine learning (ML)-based diagnostic models for differentiating early-stage pulmonary sarcoidosis using indices from routine peripheral blood tests. title: Integrating Natural Language Processing in Child and Adolescent Mental Health Services Research Using Normalization Process Theory: Implementation Report.
abstract: Anxiety problems are prevalent among autistic children and adolescents and those with attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD). Natural language processing (NLP) is increasingly used to structure information from electronic health records (EHRs), but its implementation within secure child and adolescent mental health services (CAMHS) research environments is less frequently reported. title: Generative Large Language Models for Psychiatric Concept Detection in Spanish-Language Electronic Health Records: Development and Evaluation Study.
abstract: The accurate detection of clinical symptoms in electronic health records (EHRs) is pivotal for advancing large-scale genetic and longitudinal studies in psychiatry. Free-text clinical notes are an essential source of symptom-level information, particularly in psychiatry; however, the automated extraction of symptoms from clinical text remains challenging. title: Psychological and Neurodevelopmental Correlates of Extreme Demand Avoidance in a Clinical Sample, an Exploratory Study.
journal: Autism research : official journal of the International Society for Autism Research
abstract: Extreme/pathological demand avoidance (EDA) is a behavioral profile characterized by the avoidance of everyday demands, with significant impact on the individuals and those around them. Little is understood regarding the correlates and drivers of EDA; understanding these better may lead to targeted interventions and support strategies.
